project_type: Krayin CRM SaaS — Laravel 12 + Concord/Konekt package system, multi-tenant (Spatie v4, per-tenant DB), Blade + Alpine/Vue 3 frontend, Tailwind CSS
build_system: Composer; no compile step for PHP. Frontend uses Vite but is not rebuilt per-package. All package ServiceProviders must be registered in bootstrap/providers.php.
test_framework: Pest 3 with pest-plugin-laravel. Run: php artisan test --compact
verification_instructions: 1) composer install; 2) php artisan migrate --database=tenant (or php artisan test --compact); 3) ./vendor/bin/pint for formatting; 4) php artisan route:list | grep telephony to confirm routes registered
environment_constraints: Never modify core Krayin files (packages/Webkul/Admin, Contact, Activity, etc.) except bootstrap/providers.php. Never run destructive DB commands. Never deploy to production. Multi-tenant: queues_are_tenant_aware_by_default=true; jobs get tenant context automatically via Spatie. Tenant DB connection name: 'tenant'. Landlord DB connection name: 'landlord'. Per-package migrations use loadMigrationsFrom() which picks them up when running php artisan migrate --database=tenant inside makeCurrent() context. Tenant migrations must go in packages/Webkul/Telephony/src/Database/Migrations/ — NOT in database/migrations/tenant/ (that is for app-level migrations). Webhook route must be at root domain (no tenant subdomain prefix), using 'web' middleware without CSRF, with a landlord routing table to map Twilio phone numbers to tenants — exactly as UnifiedInbox does for Meta channels.
contribution_requirements: Every change updates CHANGELOG.md under the topmost unreleased heading. Never invent PR numbers. Never bump KRAYIN_VERSION. Run ./vendor/bin/pint before committing. Add TelephonyServiceProvider to bootstrap/providers.php. All schema changes go through migrations. Never modify Admin/Config/menu.php or Admin/Config/acl.php directly — merge into those arrays from the Telephony package Config/.
key_patterns: 1) Two-provider pattern: {ModuleName}ServiceProvider (routes, views, translations, migrations, config merges, sub-providers) + ModuleServiceProvider (Concord model registration). 2) Contracts/Model/ModelProxy triple for each model. 3) Repositories extend Webkul\Core\Eloquent\Repository, model() returns contract string. 4) Admin menu/ACL merged via mergeConfigFrom(__DIR__.'/../Config/menu.php', 'menu.admin') in register(). 5) View injection without touching core: listen to view_render_event strings in EventServiceProvider; handler receives $viewRenderManager and calls $viewRenderManager->addTemplate('telephony::...'); 6) Webhook tenant resolution: landlord DB table maps provider account ID → tenant_id; use $tenant->execute(fn() => ...) to run logic in tenant context. 7) Jobs are tenant-aware automatically (queues_are_tenant_aware_by_default=true); no TenantAware interface needed unless opting out. 8) Per-tenant credentials stored in core_config table (code e.g. 'telephony.credentials.account_sid', 'telephony.credentials.auth_token', etc.) — same pattern used by email/other integrations. 9) Route group pattern: Route::middleware(['web'])->withoutMiddleware([ValidateCsrfToken::class])->prefix('telephony')->name('telephony.webhook.') for public webhooks; Route::middleware(['web','admin_locale','user'])->prefix(config('app.admin_path'))->name('admin.telephony.') for CRM routes. 10) view_render_event hooks available on Contact/Person view page: 'admin.contact.persons.view.actions.before/after' (for click-to-call button) and 'admin.contact.persons.view.right.before/after' (for call history panel).
directory_structure: packages/Webkul/{ModuleName}/src/ — module root. Subdirs: Providers/, Contracts/, Models/, Repositories/, Http/Controllers/, Routes/, Database/Migrations/, Resources/views/, Resources/lang/, Config/. bootstrap/providers.php — all service providers registered here. database/migrations/landlord/ — landlord-only schema. database/migrations/tenant/ — app-level tenant migrations (for non-package schema). packages/Webkul/{Module}/src/Database/Migrations/ — package-level tenant migrations, picked up by loadMigrationsFrom(). .agents/tasks/ — FEAT artifacts only, never committed.
